title: First call with a Doha restaurant group about a booking app, Arabic-accented English

brief.title: Booking app for Bayt Al Zaatar
brief.goals: Understand the branches; give a price and timeline; agree a demo

documents.title: My profile
documents.text: Rania Haddad: 6 years, Flutter and Firebase. Past work: Mezze House ordering app (Beirut, 2024), Qahwa Corner loyalty app (Amman, 2025). Phase 1: table booking, Arabic and English, WhatsApp confirmations. Timeline: 10 weeks.

events.text: Good afternoon Rania. So, you did before an app for restaurants, yes?
events.reference:
Yes, two for restaurants and cafes.
- **Mezze House**: ordering app, Beirut
- **Qahwa Corner**: loyalty app, Amman
Arabic: تسأل إذا عملتِ تطبيقًا للمطاعم من قبل.

bad.answer:
Yes, we already integrated Talabat for Mezze House.
Arabic: تسأل عن خبرتك مع المطاعم.

events.text: Yes, Mezze House in Beirut and Qahwa Corner in Amman.
Good. We have 70,000 riyal for this project, including the design.

facts: Them: 70,000 QAR for the project including design (minute 2)

events.text: Design and app together would be 64,000 riyals.
We have 6 branches, all of them in Doha.
The customers, they get a message on WhatsApp when they book?
events.reference:
Yes, a WhatsApp confirmation for every booking.
- **Languages**: Arabic and English
Arabic: تسأل إذا كان الزبون يستلم رسالة واتساب عند الحجز.

bad.answer:
Yes, and a reminder goes out before the booking too.
Arabic: نعم، ويصل تذكير على واتساب قبل ٢٤ ساعة من الحجز.

events.text: Yes, WhatsApp confirmations are in phase one.
One moment please, my manager is calling me.

bad.answer:
Of course, no problem.
Arabic: تقول لحظة من فضلك.

events.text: Okay, I am back. How many weeks you need for all this?
events.reference:
10 weeks for phase 1.
- **Includes**: design, booking, WhatsApp
Arabic: تسأل كم أسبوعًا يحتاج المشروع.

events.text: Sorry, again, how many weeks you said?
events.reference:
10 weeks.
Arabic: تسأل مرة أخرى عن عدد الأسابيع.

bad.answer:
About 12 weeks.
Arabic: تسأل عن المدة.

events.text: So the 70 thousand is enough, yes?
events.reference:
Yes, 64,000 riyals, inside your 70,000.
- **Includes**: design and the app
Arabic: تسأل إذا كانت السبعون ألفًا كافية.

bad.answer:
It will be 80,000 with the design.
Arabic: تسأل عن السعر.

events.text: Very good. You have questions for me?
events.reference:
Yes, one.
- **Demo**: can we show you a demo next week?
Arabic: تسأل إذا كان عندك أسئلة.

bad.answer:
How many branches do you have?
Arabic: تسأل إذا كان عندك أسئلة.

Yes, one question.
Arabic: أخبرني كم عدد الفروع عندكم
